title: The Nan Madol Ruins
hook: Why do ancient stones rise from the ocean's depths?
headline: The city built on water's secrets

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: Spanish navigator Álvaro de Mendaña first recorded Nan Madol in 1545 during his expedition.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Archaeologists date the main construction to between 1100 and 1400 AD.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: The massive basalt columns were moved using unknown engineering, baffling ancient researchers today.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent sonar surveys reveal a hidden tunnel beneath the lagoon, still unexplored deep.

end.line: Did hidden tunnels lift the city from sea?

description: Explore the mystery of Nan Madol's stone city built on water.
